test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If sec θ + tan θ = 5. then what is the value of sec θ - tan θ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For the identity **sec²θ − tan²θ = 1**, it follows that **(secθ + tanθ)(secθ − tanθ) = 1**.

This means **secθ − tanθ** is the **reciprocal** of **secθ + tanθ**.

Given **secθ + tanθ = 5**, then **secθ − tanθ = 1/5**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/416de265cfb99ebf2bce8a77a216fb8eea6e2f8f84cf304c6aadbf0105ba979d.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ **secθ + tanθ = 5**

**Formula Used:**

⇒ **sec²θ − tan²θ = 1**

**Calculations:**

⇒ (secθ + tanθ) × (secθ − tanθ) = 1

⇒ 5 × (secθ − tanθ) = 1

⇒ secθ − tanθ = 1/5

**∴ The correct answer is 1/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Standard identities: **sin²θ + cos²θ = 1** and **1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ**.

Cosecant-Cotangent Relation

Similar to sec-tan, if **cosecθ + cotθ = x**, then **cosecθ − cotθ = 1/x**.

Finding Individual Ratios

By adding the two equations, **2secθ = x + 1/x** and **2tanθ = x − 1/x**.</p
